# OfficeAIM

> OfficeAIM is a 100% free, open-source educational laboratory and interactive campus dedicated to autonomous AI agent workflows, prompt engineering, and modern web architectures.

## Core Pages & Directories
- [Landing Page](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/): Overview of the open educational platform, architecture, and free tooling.
- [Learn Directory](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/learn.html): Minimalist learning pathways covering workflows, blueprints, interactive modules, and the OfficeAIM Prompt Vault (/learn/prompts).
- [AI Skills Library](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/skills.html): 26 production-ready AI agent prompts formatted with guided natural language instructions and cross-LLM launcher.
- [Prompt Generator](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/prompt-generator.html): 3-stage interactive prompt engineering workbench with 6 structural frameworks (CRISP, CO-STAR, RISEN, Automator, RTF, Chain-of-Thought), live quality telemetry, 24 domain presets, and local storage vault.
- [Newsroom & Intelligence](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news.html): Latest telemetry, release updates, and technical breakthroughs.
- [Community & Mentorship](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/community.html): Free community learning, YouTube courses, and mentorship channels.

## Technical Architecture & Blueprints
- [Architectural Blueprint](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/blueprint.html): Deep dive into multi-agent systems, client-side sovereignty, and edge deployments.
- [Automated Workflows](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/use-cases.html): Step-by-step guides for connecting n8n, Supabase, and Google Gemini into production pipelines.
- [Security & Trust](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/security.html): Zero-trust security model, client-side data privacy, and compliance guidelines.
- [Realtime Board](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/board.html): Directory of the 19 specialist AI agents and what each one does.

## Free Open-Source Tooling
- [n8n Automation Vault](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/workflows.html): 98 production-ready n8n workflow JSON blueprints across AI agents, webhooks, Supabase databases, and automated notifications.
- [Free Stack Kit](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/free-stack-kit.html): Curated zero-cost tech stack guide for solo developers and builders.
- [Web Blueprint Studio](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/website-creator.html): Answer a few questions and get a complete website blueprint: build prompt, stack setup guide and launch roadmap.
- [Viralist Studio](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/viralist-studio.html): Short-form video blueprint compiler for terminal AI agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI / Antigravity, OpenCode) and Remotion, featuring local Voicebox TTS, Suno music briefs, low-budget mode, and animated scene previews.
- [QR Generator](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/qr-generator.html): Zero-telemetry client-side SVG QR code generator.
- [Library Tracker](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/resources/library-tracker.html): Library and loan tracker with AI vision for inventory and student management.

## News & Research Articles
- [100 AI websites: find the few that matter](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news/100-ai-websites-find-the-tools-that-matter.html): How to filter, test, and keep the AI tools that genuinely improve your workflow.
- [Building an AI MVP in Days](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news/ai-mvp-days.html): How modern startups utilize AI APIs, n8n orchestration, and Supabase to bootstrap and launch MVPs.
- [Ideogram 4.5: image editing without the drift](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news/ideogram-4-5-consistent-ai-image-editing.html): Why Ideogram 4.5 consistency focus and persistent AI tools matter for creators and teams.
- [Meta-prompting: AI that writes its own prompts](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news/meta-prompting.html): Meta-prompting lets AI models draft and refine their own prompts; how it works and when to apply it.
- [OpenAI Dots: the always-on AI agent](https://officeaimhq.netlify.app/news/openai-dots-always-on-ai-agents.html): How always-on background AI agents move from answering prompts to managing projects.
